key_insight: CliQ-RRG turns radiology report generation into a clinically guided, two-stage process that aligns images with disease-aware text signals and then rewrites them into concise QA-style reports.
clinical_relevance: The approach aims to produce more interpretable, clinically grounded chest X-ray reports that better capture diagnostic cues and multi-view context for radiology workflows.
method: Stage 1: Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment with predicted disease embeddings.
Stage 1: Prior-Guided Attention Module (PrAM) to model current and prior scan relationships.
Stage 2: GraphRAG-guided retrieval plus an LLM to convert intermediate text into QA pairs and diagnostic summaries.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains over prior methods on two public chest X-ray benchmarks, improving both lexical and clinical evaluation metrics.
watch_item: Performance depends on reliable disease prediction, retrieval quality, and benchmark-style evaluation; real-world deployment may be affected by domain shift and integration complexity.
paper_title: CliQ-RRG: Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation
